2120912598006997240.text:
Some context on the Daiyan Henley trade that did not go through between the Broncos and Chargers, per sources.

It is not uncommon for one team to have some medical concerns about a player while another does not. In this case, Denver had concerns about Henley following his physical.

Even then, the Broncos still wanted Henley with Denver and LA discussing revised trade alternatives throughout the day, taking into account those concerns. In the end, no agreement was reached. The deal was off.
